{{Otheruses|Imperial Defense}}
The '''Imperial Defense Fund''' was a law enacted during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. For every purchase made in the space of 100 days after the 50th anniversary of [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]], they would give five percent of the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the Imperial Defense fund.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
